sources.snippet: The Pythia Scaling Suite is a collection of models developed to facilitate interpretability research (see paper). It contains two sets of eight models of sizes 70M, 160M, 410M, 1B, 1.4B, 2.8B, 6.9B, and 12B. sources.title: Pythia 160M — Hardware Requirements & Compatibility | llmrun
sources.snippet: Chat Pythia 160M is part of EleutherAI's Pythia training suite, a collection of models trained on the same data in the same order at multiple scales to enable rigorous scientific research into how language models learn. At 160 million parameters, it is the smallest model in the suite and runs on virtually any hardware.
